object_description: large symmetrical crown-shaped volume enclosing a cylindrical central block
design_condition: The extensive crown occupies most of the available perimeter around a central cylinder, leaving limited green space between the building and the surrounding wall and producing constrained walks at the northern and southern edges.

positive.statement: The east-west axis establishes a strong relationship with the existing prison.
The undulated facades soften the large dimension of the form and establish a morphological relationship with the central cylinder.
Four of the six walks have adequate clearances in the corners of the site.

negative.statement: The large extension leaves no quality green spaces between the surrounding wall and the building.
The suspended walkways compromise the apparent simplicity of the scheme.
The concavity of the corridors disrupts their control by reducing the guards' visual field.
The aerial walkways are required to connect the divisions to the central common services.
The organization confines staff to the heart of the complex without a relation to the larger landscape.
The proposal presents an above-average volume and construction cost.
The crown device makes it difficult to carry out the project in stages.
